author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm) — width=384, BiGRU=160 — seed=42
abstract: Capacity sweep on the best config to aid long-sequence classification (ncRNA) and APA while preserving PRS/MRL gains. Uses Conv+Pooling(mean↔LSE τ=0.25, len-norm) + BiGRU(160), scalar-gated fusion with post-fusion LayerNorm; hidden_dim=384.
